name: knap-template
description: Local, source-first Markdown publishing with Knap templates and Pandoc

scripts.check: knap validate templates/frontmatter.kmd && knap validate templates/reference-index.kmd
scripts.html: npm run render && pandoc build/report.md --citeproc --standalone -o build/report.html
scripts.pdf: npm run render && pandoc build/report.md --citeproc --pdf-engine=xelatex -o build/report.pdf
